---
title: "Curriculum"
---

The canonical sequence starts with control authority and ends with a system design review. Each block answers one design question and adds one piece to [AutoResearch](../case-studies/autoresearch.qmd), the agent the course builds. The [build roadmap](../case-studies/autoresearch.qmd#building-autoresearch-block-by-block) shows what each block adds, and the [design exercises](../exercises/index.qmd) combine topics.

| Block | Topic | Study question |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | [Agent Fundamentals — What Is an Agent?](01-agent-fundamentals.qmd) | What changes when a model can control a trajectory of actions? |
| 02 | [Agent Loop and State Machines](02-agent-loop-state-machines.qmd) | When should transitions be explicit in the controller? |
| 03 | [Tool Use](03-tool-use.qmd) | How does a controller turn a proposed action into a validated operation? |
| 04 | [Context, State, and Memory](04-context-state-memory.qmd) | Which evidence should enter a model call, and what must survive a restart? |
| 05 | [Reasoning and Planning](05-reasoning-planning.qmd) | What makes a plan worth maintaining across observations? |
| 06 | [Core Agent Architectures](06-agent-architectures.qmd) | Who should own the next decision and the state needed to make it? |
| 07 | [Multi-Agent Systems](07-multi-agent-systems.qmd) | When does splitting roles improve a shared outcome? |
| 08 | [MCP and Agent Interoperability](08-mcp-interoperability.qmd) | Which boundary should be standardized for independently developed components to work together? |
| 09 | [Agent Evaluation](09-agent-evaluation.qmd) | How can the evaluation attribute a gain to an architectural change? |
| 10 | [Reliability and Failure Recovery](10-reliability-recovery.qmd) | How does the system resume accurately when an operation fails or its outcome is ambiguous? |
| 11 | [Long-Horizon Agents](11-long-horizon-agents.qmd) | How can a run resume hours later and still know what to do next? |
| 12 | [Production Agent Infrastructure](12-production-infrastructure.qmd) | What must the runtime guarantee when many agent runs share the same infrastructure? |
| 13 | [Learning Agents and Reinforcement Learning](13-learning-agents-rl.qmd) | What evidence shows that training improved the policy that drives the agent? |
| 14 | [Agentic System Design](14-agentic-system-design.qmd) | What evidence justifies deploying the added autonomy? |
